stories.headline: Brent nears $100 as Houthis blockade Red Sea and tankers are hit in Hormuz

key_facts.fact: Brent crude jumped nearly 5% on Wednesday, July 22, to above $95 a barrel, its highest in almost six weeks, and US WTI rose more than 4% to above $88; prices are up about 30% since the start of the month and more than 55% year to date.
key_facts.excerpt: International Brent crude rose nearly 5% to above $95/bbl, its highest level in almost 6 weeks, while US crude climbed more than 4% to above $88/bbl. The gains extend a strong upward trend, with prices up about 30% since the start of the month and more than 55% year to date.

key_facts.fact: Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has collapsed: just 13 vessels transited on Monday and 9 on Tuesday, according to MarineTraffic data, in a waterway that normally carries about a fifth of global oil supply.
key_facts.excerpt: As a result, traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has fallen sharply, with just 13 vessels transiting Monday and 9 on Tuesday, according to MarineTraffic data.

key_facts.fact: Trump wrote on his social media platform on Wednesday morning that the US 'will bomb and destroy ONE BRIDGE OR POWER PLANT' every time Iran shoots at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump is threatening to attack Iran's critical infrastructure, writing on his social media platform Wednesday morning that the U.S. "will bomb and destroy ONE BRIDGE OR POWER PLANT" any time Iran "shoots at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz."

key_facts.fact: Hours later the UK Maritime Trade Operations reported a tanker hit by an unknown projectile about 70 nautical miles southwest of Al Shuqaiq, Saudi Arabia; Brent September futures gained 2% to $95.99 and WTI 1.7% to $88.27 in the following session.
key_facts.excerpt: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations on Thursday said it had received a report that a tanker was hit by an unknown projectile around 70 nautical miles southwest of Al Shuqaiq. Brent crude futures for September delivery gained 2% to $95.99 per barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude futures advanced around 1.7% to $88.27 per barrel.

key_facts.fact: Brent touched $100 a barrel for the first time since late May after Yemen's Houthis said they struck two Saudi oil tankers, opening a second chokepoint at Bab el-Mandeb; Goldman Sachs said Brent could reach $120 in the fourth quarter and average $100 next year.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures were up by US$5.83, or 6.2 per cent, at US$99.90 a barrel by 13.10 GMT after reaching US$100 a barrel for the first time since late May. ... Goldman Sachs said Brent might reach US$120 a barrel in the fourth quarter and average US$100 next year.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said the Strait of Hormuz was under their control and 'completely closed' while US operations continue, as the US military completed a 12th consecutive night of strikes on Iran.
key_facts.excerpt: The Guards said the strait was under their control and "completely closed" while US actions continued in the region, warning that no tanker would be allowed to enter or leave without coordination with Iran. The US military said it had completed a 12th consecutive night of attacks on Iran.

key_facts.fact: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told senators the Iran war has cost the US $37.5 billion so far; 18 American service members have been killed and about 447 injured since the conflict began on Feb. 28.
key_facts.excerpt: The strikes continued a day after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told senators that the cost of the Iran war has risen to $37.5 billion ... raising the number of American service members killed in the war with Iran to 18. About 447 troops have been injured in the conflict, which began on Feb. 28.

stories.headline: ECB holds rates at 2.25% and warns the Middle East energy shock has not fully hit prices

key_facts.fact: The ECB Governing Council decided on July 23 to keep its three key interest rates unchanged: the deposit facility at 2.25%, main refinancing operations at 2.40% and marginal lending facility at 2.65%.
key_facts.excerpt: The interest rates on the deposit facility, the main refinancing operations and the marginal lending facility will remain unchanged at 2.25%, 2.40% and 2.65% respectively.

key_facts.fact: The ECB said the outlook for energy prices, while highly volatile, stands 'well above the levels recorded prior to the conflict in the Middle East' and that 'the full inflationary impact of the energy shock has yet to play out'.
key_facts.excerpt: The outlook for energy prices, while highly volatile, currently stands close to the baseline of the June Eurosystem staff projections and well above the levels recorded prior to the conflict in the Middle East. Uncertainty remains high and the full inflationary impact of the energy shock has yet to play out.

key_facts.fact: The bank said it is not pre-committing to a rate path and will keep a data-dependent, meeting-by-meeting approach.
key_facts.excerpt: It will follow a data-dependent and meeting-by-meeting approach to determining the appropriate monetary policy stance. ... The Governing Council is not pre-committing to a particular rate path.

key_facts.fact: The pause comes six weeks after the ECB raised rates in June for the first time in nearly three years, a response to a war-driven energy shock that had pushed inflation to its highest since September 2023.
key_facts.excerpt: The pause comes just six weeks after the ECB raised rates for the first time in nearly three years, responding to a war-driven energy shock that had pushed inflation to its highest since September 2023.

key_facts.fact: Euro zone inflation eased to 2.8% in June from 3.2% in May, the first decline this year, with core price growth slowing to 2.4%.
key_facts.excerpt: The decision follows confirmation last week that eurozone inflation eased to 2.8% in June from May's 3.2%, the first decline this year, with core price growth slowing to 2.4%.

key_facts.fact: Energy inflation in the euro area ran at 8.5% in June and 10.8% in May, far above the headline rate.
key_facts.excerpt: Euro zone inflation dipped to 2.8% in June from 3.2% in May, but energy inflation stood at 8.5% and 10.8% in those months.

stories.headline: Lilly's retatrutide cuts body weight up to 22.6% in two more Phase 3 obesity trials

key_facts.fact: Eli Lilly announced on July 23 positive topline results from TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3, two pivotal Phase 3 trials of retatrutide, a first-in-class GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon triple hormone receptor agonist; both met their primary endpoint.
key_facts.excerpt: INDIANAPOLIS, July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY) ... today announced positive topline results from TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3, two pivotal Phase 3 trials evaluating retatrutide, an investigational, first-in-class GIP, GLP-1, and glucagon triple hormone receptor agonist. In both studies, retatrutide met the primary endpoint.

key_facts.fact: In TRIUMPH-2, which randomized 1,152 adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight, patients on retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg and 12 mg lost an average of 12.7%, 19.1% and 20.8% of body weight at 80 weeks versus 4.0% on placebo, with A1C reductions of up to 1.6%.
key_facts.excerpt: Participants taking retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg lost an average of 29.8 lbs (12.7%), 45.4 lbs (19.1%), and 49.6 lbs (20.8%), respectively, alongside A1C reductions of up to an average of 1.6%. ... Placebo -4.0% ... The study randomized 1,152 participants.

key_facts.fact: In TRIUMPH-3, which randomized 1,949 adults with severe obesity (BMI at or above 35) and established cardiovascular disease, the 12 mg dose cut body weight 22.6% (55.8 lbs) at 80 weeks versus 3.2% on placebo.
key_facts.excerpt: Percent change in body weight from avg. baseline of 111.4 kg ... Retatrutide 9 mg -21.6% ... Retatrutide 12 mg -22.6% (-25.3 kg; -55.8 lbs) ... Placebo -3.2%. The study randomized 1,949 participants in a 1:1:2 ratio.

key_facts.fact: Cardiovascular events were fewer than anticipated in both arms of TRIUMPH-3: 44 MACE-5 events on retatrutide versus 52 on placebo, a hazard ratio of 0.82 (95% CI 0.55-1.22); the narrower MACE-3 endpoint showed a hazard ratio of 1.12 (95% CI 0.64-1.96).
key_facts.excerpt: there were 44 MACE-5 ... events observed in participants randomized to retatrutide (pooled 9 mg and 12 mg) and 52 events observed in those randomized to placebo, resulting in a hazard ratio of 0.82 (95.0% CI: 0.55 to 1.22). There were 27 MACE-3 ... events in participants randomized to retatrutide and 23 in those randomized to placebo, resulting in a hazard ratio of 1.12.

key_facts.fact: At the highest dose in TRIUMPH-3, retatrutide cut triglycerides 37.0%, non-HDL cholesterol 16.5%, systolic blood pressure 9.3 mmHg, waist circumference 19.0 cm and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein 51.2%.
key_facts.excerpt: the highest dose delivering average reductions of 37.0% in triglycerides, 16.5% in non-HDL cholesterol, 9.3 mmHg in systolic blood pressure, 7.5 in (19.0 cm) in waist circumference, and 51.2% in high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP).

key_facts.fact: Discontinuation due to adverse events reached 11.6% at 9 mg in TRIUMPH-2 and 13.5% at 12 mg in TRIUMPH-3, versus roughly 5% on placebo; Lilly plans to file a Biologics License Application with the FDA in Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Discontinuation rates due to adverse events in TRIUMPH-2 were 3.8% (4 mg), 11.6% (9 mg), and 7.7% (12 mg) with retatrutide, compared with 4.9% for placebo. Discontinuation rates due to adverse events in TRIUMPH-3 were 9.8% (9 mg) and 13.5% (12 mg) ... compared with 4.8% for placebo. ... plans to subsequently submit retatrutide in Q1 2027 for U.S. approval.

stories.headline: FDA clears GSK's Jideytro for ROS1 lung cancer a week after its $10.6B Nuvalent buyout closed

key_facts.fact: GSK said on July 22 that the FDA approved Jideytro (zidesamtinib), a ROS1-selective inhibitor, for adults with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer who had already received a ROS1 kinase inhibitor.
key_facts.excerpt: GSK plc (LSE/NYSE: GSK) today announced the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Jideytro (zidesamtinib), a ROS1 selective inhibitor, for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received a prior ROS1 kinase inhibitor.

key_facts.fact: The clearance came ahead of the original target action date of 18 September 2026 and follows Breakthrough Therapy and Orphan Drug designations.
key_facts.excerpt: The approval comes ahead of the original target action date of 18 September 2026 and follows the FDA's Breakthrough Therapy and Orphan Drug Designations.

key_facts.fact: Approval rests on the global single-arm ARROS-1 Phase I/II trial: in 117 previously treated patients the objective response rate was 44% (95% CI 34-53%), with duration-of-response rates of 82% at six months and 69% at 12 months.
key_facts.excerpt: In the overall population (n=117), the objective response rate (ORR) was 44% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 34-53%). Duration of response (DOR) rates at six and 12 months were 82% and 69%, respectively.

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved the drug two months earlier than projected, a week after GSK closed its $10.6 billion acquisition of Nuvalent; GSK estimates about 50,000 people worldwide are diagnosed with this form of lung cancer each year, particularly non-smokers.
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA on Wednesday approved one of Nuvalent's lung cancer medicines two months earlier than projected ... GSK's $10.6 billion acquisition of Nuvalent is delivering surprisingly early results ... The company estimates about 50,000 people globally get diagnosed with this form of cancer each year, particularly non-smokers.

key_facts.fact: It is GSK's first approved medicine in lung cancer; a second Nuvalent drug, neladalkib for ALK-altered NSCLC, is under FDA review with a decision date of 27 November 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Jideytro is GSK's first approved medicine in lung cancer. The company is advancing additional medicines from the recent Nuvalent acquisition, including neladalkib (NVL-655) for patients with ALK-altered NSCLC, which is currently under FDA review with a target decision date of 27 November 2026.

stories.headline: Zelensky talks to Witkoff and Kushner as Ukraine widens deep strikes on Russia's economy

key_facts.fact: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on July 22 he spoke with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, Trump's special envoys, describing 'a good and important conversation about how to intensify diplomacy and bring peace closer'.
key_facts.excerpt: President Volodymyr Zelensky on July 22 spoke with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys leading efforts to broker a peace deal between Russia and Ukraine. The officials held "a good and important conversation about how to intensify diplomacy and bring peace closer."

key_facts.fact: The call comes amid a six-month freeze in negotiations: Kyiv, Moscow and Washington have not held trilateral talks since meeting in Abu Dhabi in February, after the US largely dropped its Ukraine diplomacy to focus on Iran.
key_facts.excerpt: The latest discussion comes amid a six-month freeze in peace negotiations among Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington, who have not held trilateral talks since meeting in Abu Dhabi in February. The U.S. largely dropped diplomatic efforts in Ukraine and Russia after launching its invasion of Iran, while the Kremlin dug into its maximalist demands.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Ukraine struck logistics hubs in Russia's Krasnodar and Stavropol regions that supply the Russian army with drone components and navigation equipment, plus an oil depot; the Krasnodar governor said one person was killed.
key_facts.excerpt: "Today, Ukraine's long-range sanctions successfully struck important targets in Russia's Krasnodar and Stavropol regions – logistics hubs involved in supplying the Russian army with drone components, navigation equipment, and other gear – as well as another oil depot," Zelenskyy wrote. Vladimir Kondratyev, the governor of southern Krasnodar said one person was killed.

key_facts.fact: It was the third strike in a week on warehouses of Wildberries, Russia's largest online retailer; earlier hits on its facilities in the Moscow and Tambov regions killed eight workers.
key_facts.excerpt: The Ukrainian military struck warehouses belonging to Russia's largest online retailer, Wildberries, in the third attack targeting such facilities in a week ... with Ukrainian drones targeting its facilities in the Moscow and Tambov regions. Those hits left eight workers dead.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces commander Robert Brovdi said Kyiv hit 13 more Russian 'shadow fleet' vessels in the Azov and Black seas over two days.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukrainian drone strikes have hit another 13 Russian shadow fleet vessels in the Azov Sea and the Black Sea over the last two days, Commander of Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces Robert Brovdi, known as "Madyar," said on July 22.

key_facts.fact: Russia launched 216 drones and four missiles overnight into July 22, killing at least one person in Odesa and injuring at least five in Kyiv, including three children.
key_facts.excerpt: On July 22 alone, Ukrainian military forces reported that 216 drones and four missiles were launched by Russia overnight. The strikes killed at least one person in the southern port city of Odesa and left at least five more injured in Kyiv, including three children.

key_facts.fact: The Kremlin has hardened its position, dropping earlier plans to return occupied parts of the Sumy and Kharkiv regions and intending to keep them as buffer zones while it seeks all of Donetsk and Luhansk.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia no longer plans to return parts of Ukraine's occupied territory as part of any future peace agreement and instead intends to keep them as permanent buffer zones ... Putin remains determined to seize all of Ukraine's Donetsk region by force while retaining occupied areas in the border regions of Sumy and Kharkiv.

stories.headline: Lula opens R$18.5bn credit line as new 25% US tariff on Brazilian goods takes effect

key_facts.fact: President Lula announced on July 22 the release of R$18.5 billion (about $3.65 billion) in credit for companies hit by the additional 25% US tariff on Brazilian products and by the war in the Middle East, in a package the government calls 'Brasil Soberano 3'.
key_facts.excerpt: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) anunciou nesta quarta-feira (22) a liberação de R$ 18,5 bilhões em crédito para empresas afetadas pelas tarifas adicionais de 25% aplicadas a produtos brasileiros vendidos no mercado americano e também aquelas impactadas pela guerra no Oriente Médio. A medida é chamada de "Brasil Soberano 3" pelo governo.

key_facts.fact: The announcement landed on the same day the extra 25% US levy came into force; R$13.5 billion comes from unused Treasury money from the first Brasil Soberano plan and from rural debt renegotiation, and R$5 billion from state development bank BNDES.
key_facts.excerpt: No dia da entrada em vigor do novo tarifaço dos Estados Unidos, o governo federal anunciou um novo pacote de apoio às empresas brasileiras. Batizada de Plano Brasil Soberano 3, a iniciativa prevê R$ 18,5 bilhões em linhas de crédito com juros subsidiados para exportadores e setores considerados estratégicos.

key_facts.fact: Provisional measure MP 1.379/2026, signed by Lula and the finance and industry ministers, was published in an extra edition of the Diário Oficial on Wednesday night, takes effect immediately and goes to Congress, which has up to 120 days to vote on it.
key_facts.excerpt: Assinada pelo presidente Lula e pelos ministros da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, e do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços (MDIC), Márcio Elias Rosa, a MP nº 1.379/2026 entra em vigor imediatamente e foi encaminhada ao Congresso Nacional, que deverá apreciá-la no prazo de até 120 dias.

key_facts.fact: The money is split across three groups: companies hit by US Section 232 and Section 301 tariffs, strategic industrial sectors such as chemicals, pharma, autos, fertilizers and critical minerals, and exporters to the Persian Gulf disrupted by the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: o programa será dividido em três frentes de atendimento: empresas afetadas pelas tarifas comerciais dos Estados Unidos, setores industriais estratégicos — como químico, farmacêutico, automotivo, fertilizantes e minerais críticos — e empresas exportadoras ... 'agora não só os afetados pelas tarifas da Seção 232, mas também da Seção 301'

key_facts.fact: Financing costs range from 3% for critical-minerals processing and 6.5% for investment to 8.3% for small and mid-sized firms and 9.8% for large companies needing working capital.
key_facts.excerpt: Linha para capital de giro (Para grandes empresas e MPME): Custo financeiro de 9,8% para grandes empresas e 8,3% para micro, pequenas e médias empresas ... Linha para transformação de minerais críticos: Custo financeiro de 3% - Linha para investimento: Custo financeiro de 6,5%

key_facts.fact: It is the third round of the program, after R$30 billion in August 2025 and R$21 billion in March 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Agosto de 2025: Brasil Soberano 1: R$ 30 bilhões - Março de 2026: Brasil Soberano 2: R$ 21 bilhões - Julho de 2026: Brasil Soberano 3: R$ 18,5 bilhões

key_facts.fact: Official Brazilian estimates suggest the new duties will hit about 18% of the country's exports to the US, though trade groups warn nearly a third of US-bound shipments could be affected.
key_facts.excerpt: Official Brazilian estimates suggest the duties will impact about 18% of the country's exports to the US, though domestic trade groups warn the damage could affect nearly a third of all US-bound shipments.

stories.headline: USTR says forced-labor tariffs on 60 trading partners land as the 10% global tariff expires

key_facts.fact: In written remarks submitted to a Senate Finance Committee hearing on July 22, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said that 'as early as tomorrow, the 23rd, USTR will issue final actions against 60 trading partners for their failure to address products made with forced labor'.
key_facts.excerpt: In written materials submitted to a hearing of the US Senate Finance Committee on the 22nd, Greer said, "As early as tomorrow, the 23rd, USTR will issue final actions against 60 trading partners for their failure to address products made with forced labor."

key_facts.fact: The Section 301 forced-labor duties were pre-announced at 10% to 12.5%; South Korea was placed in a group of 54 economies facing the 12.5% rate for failing both to adopt and to enforce import bans on forced-labor goods.
key_facts.excerpt: USTR announced on the 2nd of last month that it plans to impose an additional tariff of 10% or 12.5% on imports from 60 economies that failed to block trade in products made with forced labor. It included Korea in a group of 54 economies that failed both to introduce and effectively enforce import bans on goods produced with forced labor, making it subject to the 12.5% tariff.

key_facts.fact: The move replaces the 10% global tariff imposed under Section 122 of the Trade Act after the Supreme Court ruled the administration's reciprocal tariffs unconstitutional in February; that levy, capped at 150 days, expires on July 24.
key_facts.excerpt: after the Supreme Court ruled the Trump administration's reciprocal tariffs on various countries unconstitutional in February, the administration introduced a "10% global tariff" under Section 122 of the Trade Act. The global tariff, which can be imposed for up to 150 days, will expire on the 24th.

key_facts.fact: At the same hearing Greer defended the 50% tariffs on Canadian goods and said he hopes to present the leaders of the US, Canada and Mexico with 'options' for interim trade arrangements before the end of the year.
key_facts.excerpt: Speaking before the US Senate Finance Committee, Greer said he expects "options" for interim trade arrangements to be presented to the leaders of Canada, the United States and Mexico before the end of the year.

key_facts.fact: The Section 338 tariffs on Canada, announced Monday evening and effective Aug. 19, cover roughly $20 billion of imports, about 5% of Canada's 2025 shipments to the US, across more than 500 product categories, with no USMCA exemption.
key_facts.excerpt: The Section 338 tariffs – announced Monday evening and set to take effect Aug. 19 – would apply to roughly US$20-billion of imports from Canada, or roughly 5 per cent of Canada's shipments to the U.S. in 2025 ... The duties are set to hit more than 500 product categories.
